messages:
jess: Quick Q2 capacity sync — APAC onramp target: add 2x H100 pods in SG and 1x in SYD by mid-May. Need procurement lead times + EU fallback plan. Who can own vendor options?

omar: I can own procurement and vendor outreach. Quick note: H100 reserved lead ~12–16 weeks currently. Do we want a mixed-sku fallback (A100s) for burst/fast delivery?

sasha: For the workload split: latency-sensitive chat must be H100. Embeddings/batch can be A100 spot. Suggest steady-state utilization target 70%, peak ~85%.

lin: Agree on utilization. We also need clear launch gates: perf (99th/50th), cost targets, and security/compliance for EU. Product mentioned SLA 99.9% — thats going to drive capacity.

product-ops: Heads-up: an enterprise pilot wants EU-only deployments + audit logs. If we can't promise EU capacity, launch will be delayed or require a dedicated contract.

marta: If EU is delayed, maybe offer mixed-region routing with an EU proxy to satisfy residency for now — engineering overhead but buys time. Budget cap reminder: procurement spend ceiling is $1.2M for H1.

omar: Plan: I'll collect vendor quotes and present three options:
```
1) Reserved H100 purchase — best perf, longest lead (12–16 wks)
2) Hybrid reserved + spot — medium lead, balanced cost
3) A100 contingency (spot/reserved) — fastest procurement but higher latency for chat
```

jess: Good. Can you summarize options + delta on cost and lead time in a small table? Also add an OKR row: "APAC onramp + EU fallback" with milestones.

omar: Will do. Rough stub attached to ticket after vendor calls. Also checking supplier SLAs for delivery windows.

deploy-bot: INFRA-872 created and assigned to omar: "APAC onramp procurement — vendor quotes + fallback options" <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-872>

sasha: Ops ask: set autoscale policy to prefer reserved pool up to 80% then spill to spot with preemption-safe routing. That keeps costs predictable.

lin: Draft launch criteria proposal: 1) Perf smoke on H100 in APAC (p50/p95/p99), 2) fallback routing tested end-to-end, 3) cost per 1k tokens within target, 4) legal/compliance signoff for EU. I'd push to hold launches if 2 or 4 fail.

product-ops: Action items: omar — vendor quotes by 2026-03-15; sasha — utilization sims + autoscale config by 2026-03-10; lin — draft gating doc by 2026-03-12; jess — stakeholder sync Tue 9am PT.

jess: :thumbsup: putting sync on calendar. Thanks everyone — please add notes to INFRA-872 and ping if blockers come up.

marta: FYI I'll review budget impact and send reprioritization proposal if procurement pushes past May.
